items.name: The Gunslinger +2 Dex & Con
items.description:
This tattoo grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to two physical ability scores of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the belt is worn. These bonuses are chosen when the tattoo created and cannot be changed.
It also grants a +2 competence bonus on all dex-based skill checks.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, bear's endurance, cat's grace; Cost 6,000 gp

items.name: Ring of Protection +2
items.description: This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.

items.name: Amulet of Natural Armor +2
items.description: This amulet, usually containing some type of magically preserved monster hide or other natural armor—such as bone, horn, carapace, or beast scales—toughens the wearer’s body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor from +1 to +5, depending on the kind of amulet.

items.name: Golden Mithral Scale Mail with Numerian Liner
items.description:
Scale mail is made up of dozens of small, overlapping metal plates. Similar to both splint mail and banded mail, scalemail has a flexible arrangement of scales in an attempt to avoid hindering the wearer’s mobility, but at the expense of omitting additional protective layers of armor. A suit of scale mail includes gauntlets.

items.name: Heavenly Arc
items.description: A glaive is composed of a simple blade mounted on the end of a pole about 7 feet in length.

items.name: Cloak of Resistance +2
items.description: This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

items.name: Silent Vigil
items.description:
You need at least two hands to use a bow, regardless of its size. You can use a composite longbow while mounted.

All composite bows are made with a particular Strength rating (that is, each requires a minimum Strength modifier to use with proficiency). If your Strength bonus is less than the strength rating of the composite bow, you can’t effectively use it, so you take a –2 penalty on attacks with it. items.name: Divine Scion +2 (Wis & Cha)
items.description:
The tattoo grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to two mental ability scores of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the tatoo is worn.
These bonuses are chosen when the tattoo is created and cannot be changed.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, eagle's splendor, owl's wisdom; Cost 6,000 gp
